recognize_zh: 周邊血中成群的中到大型淋巴球，細胞質中等量淡藍、核圓到略不規則、染色質中度濃縮，部分細胞可見單一明顯的中央核仁（prominent nucleolus），這種「大細胞加明顯核仁」的前淋巴球（prolymphocyte）型態是本圖的診斷線索。
features: Cluster of intermediate to large lymphoid cells, about twice the diameter of a red cell
Moderate N:C ratio with a rim of moderate pale blue cytoplasm, some with irregular angular borders
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin
Single, centrally placed prominent nucleolus visible in several cells
No smudge cells or small mature CLL-type lymphocytes in this field; red cells unremarkable
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cluster of intermediate to large lymphoid cells with moderate amounts of pale blue cytoplasm, round to slightly irregular nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin and a single prominent central nucleolus in many cells, consistent with prolymphocytes. Small mature lymphocytes and smudge cells are not present in this field. Red cells are unremarkable. In the stated context, findings are consistent with prolymphocytic progression of a B-cell lymphoproliferative disorder; the CD5-negative immunophenotype warrants careful exclusion of other B-cell neoplasms with prolymphocytic morphology.

ddx.vs: Mantle cell lymphoma can mimic prolymphocytes but typically is CD5+ with cyclin D1 and t(11;14), which were absent here.
Villous lymphocytes are smaller with polar short cytoplasmic projections and less prominent nucleoli, and the disease is CD5-negative with marked splenomegaly.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli)
ddx.vs: HCL-variant cells combine prominent nucleoli with circumferential hairy projections and are CD103+/CD11c+, CD25- and CD5-.
T-PLL cells are smaller with cytoplasmic blebs and are T-cell marker-positive with TCL1A rearrangement, rather than kappa-restricted B cells.
